_description: Global fixes index. Each fix maps to its owning spec via spec_id. Fixes not tied to a spec have spec_id: null and live in sdd/fixes.md. Spec-scoped fixes live in sdd/specs/{spec-id}/fixes.md. Maintained by: sdd-orchestrator.
_convention: Fix ID format: FIX-[gh-user]-[spec-NNN]-[seq] for spec-scoped fixes. FIX-[gh-user]-[seq] for repo-level fixes.

fixes.author: e-burgos
fixes.title: composition-remotion:smoke target cannot resolve workspace TS path aliases
fixes.description: nx run composition-remotion:smoke fails in ~400 ms, before bundling, with "Cannot find module '../../libs/timeline-core/src'" (require stack: src/__fixtures__/example-timeline.ts <- src/smoke.ts). The target runs `node -r @swc-node/register ./src/smoke.ts` with cwd libs/composition-remotion, so @swc-node/register picks up libs/composition-remotion/tsconfig.json and takes that directory as baseUrl, while the paths mappings inherited from tsconfig.base.json are written relative to the workspace root (./libs/<lib>/src/index.ts). Every @video-maker/* specifier is therefore rewritten to a path under libs/composition-remotion/libs/. Broken since spec-001 cycle-03, when the target was added: it has never produced a render.
fixes.justification: The smoke target is the only path to a real end-to-end Remotion render (CA-027 of spec-001); every automated target stubs renderMedia. With it broken there is no way to verify that a Timeline actually renders, spec-004 needs it to validate the final audio mux and spec-005 will build the render service on top of it. The fix is a target/tooling defect in an already-completed spec, not new functionality: it changes no public API, no domain module and no API contract, so opening a full SDD cycle for it is disproportionate.
fixes.test_reference: libs/composition-remotion/README.md#smoke-manual--ca-027-fuera-de-ci — manual target, never in CI (RNF-3). Executed once for real on 2026-09-08: `pnpm nx run composition-remotion:smoke` returned { outPath: "out/example-9x16.mp4", compositionId: "TimelineComposition", width: 1080, height: 1920, fps: 30, durationInFrames: 265 } in 53.2 s, and `ffprobe` on the output reports h264 1080x1920 @ 30/1, nb_frames=265, duration 8.833333 s, aac 48000 Hz stereo. VALIDATED on 2026-09-09 by the cycle-03 E2E smoke of spec-e-burgos-005-render-service: a render job created over HTTP against media/smoke-ingest bundled Remotion with webpack in the render-api process and produced out/ac9647bb-28cd-42c7-bd1c-8522b7a45d7a.mp4 (2133176 bytes), which ffprobe reports as h264 1080x1920 r_frame_rate 30/1 with nb_frames 538 (17.9333 s derived from the video stream, frameDelta 0) plus an aac 48000 Hz stereo stream. Evidence: sdd/specs/spec-e-burgos-005-render-service/cycles/cycle-03/artifacts/.
fixes.process_note: Six files instead of the five the FIX GATE allows: the sixth is libs/composition-remotion/.gitignore with a single `out/` line. The fix made the smoke produce a 9.2 MB MP4 for the first time, so the artifact had nowhere to be ignored; leaving it untracked-but-visible was worse than the extra file. No code, no contract and no third file of logic were added by it.

fixes.author: e-burgos
fixes.title: composition-remotion coverage.include does not measure src/render.ts nor src/components/**
fixes.description: libs/composition-remotion/vite.config.ts declares coverage.include as [src/helpers/**/*.ts, src/transitions/**/*.ts] with an 80% global threshold. src/render.ts (bundle + renderMedia, the most expensive and most fragile file of the lib) and src/components/** are excluded: they neither count towards the floor nor appear in the report. The lib kept a green coverage report for two specs while its only real render path was broken (FIX-e-burgos-001-001).
fixes.justification: Measurement-config change on an already completed spec: no production code, no public API, no contract and no dependency changes. Scheduled by D-6 of spec-e-burgos-005-render-service for cycle-03, which is the first cycle that exercises render.ts for real (E2E smoke with real binaries) and therefore the first one that can raise the coverage and the floor at the same time.
fixes.test_reference: pnpm nx run composition-remotion:test green with the widened include (2026-09-08): 93.33% stmts / 92.19% branch / 90.47% funcs / 93.18% lines, global 80% floor untouched, and src/render.ts now listed in the report at 76.92% stmts with lines 18, 100-121 and 131 uncovered.
fixes.process_note: src/components/** stays out of coverage.include, descoped with a written recommendation in the fix document: including it drops the lib to 68.53% funcs / 79.64% branch, and Vitest 4.1.11 per-glob thresholds did not take effect here (three key shapes tried), so the only way to include it was lowering the GLOBAL floor to ~68%, which hides the debt instead of registering it. The honest coverage of those Remotion components comes from rendering them through the Player in spec-e-burgos-006-web-studio. fixes.description: Two follow-ups declared when spec-002 cycle-03 closed and explicitly deferred to spec-005. (1) N-2: formatCliError derives the header stage token as uso whenever error.stage is null, so usage errors about an already recognized command (invalid --preset/--seed on ingest|plan|render, missing <project-root>, extra positional) lose the command stage; stageForArgument exists, is tested and has no production caller. The substantive decision is already taken and written down as D-4 of spec-e-burgos-005-render-service; D-5 scheduled the application for cycle-03, the first cycle where the API and the CLI share the translation of library errors.

fixes.author: e-burgos
fixes.title: plan fails with EDL_INVALID on real material: whisper.cpp emits zero-duration words at segment starts
fixes.description: Running render-cli run on a real 43 s Spanish voice-over (Piper voice muxed over NASA footage, media/demo-espacio) fails at the plan stage with EDL_INVALID: decisions cap-0024 and cap-0029 have endMs <= startMs. whisper.cpp (ggml-large-v3-turbo) assigns from == to offsets to the first tokens of every segment (e.g. 'Hoy' and 'te' both at 3980..3980). groupWordsForCaptions extends such a group to minDurationMs, planCaptionGroups then clamps its end to the enclosing keep, and when the keep ends exactly at the word start the clamp yields endMs == startMs. The word repair belongs at the source (the whisper.cpp parser) and the planner needs a guard so it never emits a degenerate caption group.
fixes.justification: Confirmed defect that blocks every real project whose transcription contains segment-initial zero-duration words (all of them with this model); no new contract, no new entity, two pure functions and their tests. Registered under the solo-profile FIX GATE while no cycle is open.
fixes.test_reference: pnpm nx run-many -t lint test build -p media-local auto-montage green (2026-09-10): media-local 303 tests, auto-montage 311. New cases: a same-start run of zero-duration words is spread monotonically up to the next word start; a trailing zero-duration word gets 200 ms; a caption group whose keep ends at its startMs yields no decision. Real run: render-cli run media/demo-espacio --preset software-demo --seed 0 → 129 words, 0 zero-duration, 5 concepts, 4 b-roll overlays, out/demo-espacio.mp4 1029 frames 1080x1920@30 with AAC audio.
fixes.process_note: Found by rendering a real 43 s Piper voice-over over NASA footage (media/demo-espacio, gitignored). Resolved by the steward in the main loop (no cycle open, solo profile FIX GATE) because the defect blocked the only real demo of the product; the whisper repair lives at the source so every consumer of Transcription benefits, and the planner guard keeps the EDL valid even if another transcriber emits degenerate words.

fixes.author: e-burgos
fixes.title: kinetic captions: the emphasised and active words overlap their neighbours and long words overflow the box
fixes.description: Seen on the first real render (media/demo-espacio): 'HAY' is covered by 'VOLCANES', 'NADIE' and 'CONOCE.' touch, 'CONOCEMOS.' leaves the left edge of the frame. captionWordStyle enlarges the emphasis and active words with transform: scale(), which does not take layout space, so the flex row places the neighbours as if the word were unscaled; fitCaptionFontSize sizes the line from unscaled character widths, so the emphasised word (up to 1.21x) does not fit the box it was measured for.
fixes.justification: Confirmed visual defect on every real render with the default presets; two pure helpers and the component wiring, no contract change (fontSize is still owned by the clip container, D-12), backward compatible signatures. Solo-profile FIX GATE, no cycle open.
fixes.test_reference: pnpm nx run-many -t lint test build -p composition-remotion green (2026-09-10): 30 files / 317 tests. New cases: captionWordStyle reserves symmetric margins proportional to (scale-1)/2 x estimated word width and none for a normal word; fitCaptionFontSize with emphasisIndex returns a strictly smaller size than the legacy call and smaller with a real emphasis word than with null. Real re-render of media/demo-espacio (render-cli render, 1029 frames): frames at 6 s, 12 s, 13.77 s (HAY VOLCANES TRES) and 19 s show separated words and CONOCEMOS. inside the frame.
fixes.process_note: Reported by the dev with a screenshot of the first real render. Resolved by the steward in the main loop (solo-profile FIX GATE, no cycle open). transform: scale() was kept so D-12 (the clip container owns fontSize) and the existing scale tests stay valid; the layout now reserves the scaled width through margins, and the font-size fit measures the emphasised word at emphasisScale plus the worst-case active word. At the minFontSize floor a long line still wraps to a second row by design (flexWrap), which is what happens with HAY VOLCANES / TRES.

fixes.author: e-burgos
fixes.title: caption groups run across sentence boundaries because whisper.cpp assigns the pause to the previous word
fixes.description: On the real optics ad (media/demo-01) the caption 'VOS. EN' mixed the end of one sentence with the start of the next. whisper.cpp -ml 1 gives the token before a pause the whole pause duration ('vos' 1600..2740 ms for a ~350 ms word) and starts the next token right at its end, so the gap between sentences is 0 ms and the gap-based groupWordsForCaptions cannot split them. Sentence punctuation is a timing-independent cue: a word ending in . ! ? or the ellipsis now closes the group.
fixes.justification: Confirmed on real material with the default model; one pure function in timeline-core plus its test, no contract change, backward compatible for transcripts without punctuation. Solo-profile FIX GATE, no cycle open.
fixes.test_reference: pnpm nx run-many -t lint test build -p timeline-core auto-montage composition-remotion green (2026-09-10). New case: 'que vos.' | 'En nuestra' split at the period with a 0 ms gap. Real re-plan of media/demo-01: the first caption groups no longer cross the sentence boundary.
fixes.process_note: Found while producing demo-01 with the video-producer skill. Resolved by the steward in the main loop.

fixes.author: e-burgos
fixes.title: the producer model is fixed by PRODUCER_MODEL: the user cannot choose it from the chat
fixes.description: PRODUCER_MODEL freezes the model of every producer turn at startup: claude-code-producer-agent passes config.model to --model and the chat screen has no way to change it. A cheap turn (a question about the material) and an expensive one (deciding the montage) pay the same price, and switching means restarting the service. The fix adds an allowed-models list (PRODUCER_MODELS, default sonnet,opus,haiku, which must contain PRODUCER_MODEL), an optional model field on POST /projects/:slug/producer/messages validated against that list (422 PRODUCER_MODEL_INVALID), persistence of the model in effect in session.json (claude -p --resume <id> --model <m> accepts a different model on a later turn), the models catalog on GET /projects/:slug/producer and the model of the turn on GET .../turns/:id. The web adds a model picker next to the composer and a badge with the model used on each assistant message.
fixes.justification: Explicit request of the dev ("es importante que permitas elegir el modelo que se usara") on a spec already closed. No new endpoint, module or domain entity: the change is additive on three payloads of the studio-producer contract and one env var, and it is registered field by field in sdd/api.json (EP-022, EP-023, EP-024). Solo profile FIX GATE, no cycle open.
fixes.test_reference: pnpm nx run-many -t lint test build verde en los 8 proyectos (2026-09-10); render-api 839 tests (97.99 % stmts / 92.49 % branch), web 713 tests (98.73 % stmts / 96 % branch), thresholds 80 % sin tocar coverage.include. Casos nuevos: readProducerConfig (lista, deduplicado, default fuera de la lista, lista vacia, describeProducerModel), producerCliArgs pasa el modelo del turno, handler (modelo elegido -> agente + session.json + mensaje, herencia sonnet/haiku/haiku sin model explicito, PRODUCER_MODEL_INVALID sin reservar turno, claves exactas de EP-022/EP-024), parse-producer (catalogo obligatorio y rechazos), cliente (body con y sin model), ProducerComposer (opciones, descripcion, bloqueo) y ProducerPage (arranque en session.model, fallback al default, badge por mensaje). E2E real apps/web/e2e/producer-smoke.mjs con PRODUCER_SMOKE_STOP_AFTER=5 (2026-09-10 23:33): el selector ofrece exactamente sonnet/opus/haiku, se cambia a haiku, un turno real responde en 9 s con model haiku en el registro del turno, work/producer/session.json en disco queda {"sessionId":"c6564061-d7d4-46fa-aed8-01430ab115ec","model":"haiku",...} y el badge del mensaje del asistente dice haiku. Evidencia: sdd/specs/spec-e-burgos-015-studio-producer/cycles/cycle-02/artifacts/producer-smoke-09-model-haiku.png.

fixes.author: e-burgos
fixes.title: a storyboard job dies with AI_AGENT_FAILED and no provider detail when CLAUDE_CLI_MODEL is unset
fixes.description: With CLAUDE_CLI_MODEL unset the adapter omitted --model and the CLI fell back to the developer default model, which Claude Code 2.1.123 rejects with 'API Error: 400 ... claude_code_version_too_old'. The job failed in 5-10 s and, because claudeCliAiAgent threw failed(payload.subtype) and dropped payload.result, the API answered 502 AI_AGENT_FAILED with no trace of the real cause, so the studio producer guessed out loud that an API key was missing. The fix pins CLAUDE_CLI_MODEL to sonnet by default (the adapter never calls the CLI without --model), carries the provider detail in the error payload as details.subtype and details.result trimmed to 600 chars with a specific hint for claude_code_version_too_old, and lets the storyboard and voice jobs take an optional model validated against the PRODUCER_MODELS list so the producer can forward the model chosen in the chat.
fixes.justification: Confirmed bug on the real project media/display-ads: the producer got stuck and misreported the cause to the user. No new endpoint, module or domain entity: one env default, one error payload widened with two optional fields, and one optional body field on the existing POST /projects/:slug/jobs (EP-012). Solo profile FIX GATE, no cycle open.
fixes.test_reference: pnpm nx run-many -t lint test build verde en los 8 proyectos (2026-09-11); render-api 848 tests, 98.01 % stmts / 92.64 % branch, piso 80 % sin tocar coverage.include. Casos nuevos: readAiAgentConfig con default sonnet y 'nunca deja el modelo sin declarar'; claudeCliArgs siempre termina en --model (del pedido si viene, del servicio si no); AI_AGENT_FAILED publica subtype/result, recorta a AI_AGENT_DETAIL_MAX_CHARS=600 con '...' y da el hint 'update Claude Code: run `claude update`' ante claude_code_version_too_old, sin publicar claves cuando el CLI no informa detalle; jobs-handler reenvia el model del body al agente (['haiku', null]) y rechaza uno fuera de la lista con JOB_MODEL_INVALID en storyboard y en voice sin registrar job. Smoke real (mktemp -d con copia de media/smoke-ingest, puerto 4411, PRODUCER_MODELS=sonnet,opus,haiku,bogus-model-for-probe): POST model=gpt-5 -> 422 JOB_MODEL_INVALID expected 'one of sonnet, opus, haiku, bogus-model-for-probe'; POST model=bogus-model-for-probe -> job failed en 8,7 s con error.result literal del CLI "There's an issue with the selected model (bogus-model-for-probe). It may not exist or you may not have access to it. Run --model to pick a different model." — antes del fix ese payload no traia ningun detalle.

fixes.author: e-burgos
fixes.title: neither the CLI nor the montage job can choose the output format: everything renders 9x16
fixes.description: resolveMontageInputs takes options.outputPreset but nobody passes it: autoMontage is called without it from tools/render-cli and from the montage job, so every project falls back to reels-9x16 even when the A-roll is a landscape screen recording. youtube-16x9 already exists in libs/timeline-core. The fix exposes it end to end: --format <reels-9x16|tiktok-9x16|shorts-9x16|youtube-16x9> on render-cli plan and run, and format with the same values on the montage job (422 MONTAGE_FORMAT_INVALID), both forwarded to autoMontage as outputPreset. The default stays reels-9x16 in both paths and the plan report prints the resolved format so the choice is visible.
fixes.justification: Explicit request of the dev after a 16:9 screen recording came out vertical. No new endpoint, module or domain entity: one optional CLI flag, one optional body field on EP-012 and one argument already accepted by the library. Solo profile FIX GATE, no cycle open.
fixes.test_reference: pnpm nx run-many -t lint test build verde en los 8 proyectos (2026-09-11); render-cli 180 tests (98.55 % stmts / 93.57 % branch), render-api 858 tests (98.02 % / 92.69 %), timeline-core 265 tests (97.8 % / 92.56 %), piso 80 % sin tocar coverage.include. fixes.author: e-burgos
fixes.title: the voice job needs a storyboard: a loose script cannot be synthesized from the studio
fixes.description: The voice job reads work/storyboard.json, selects its scenes and writes one track per scene, so a project whose script is a plain work/producer/script.txt has no way to get a voice over from the app: the producer had to fall back to the Piper recipe of the skill, which the allowed-tools list of the agent does not authorize. The fix adds a second input to the same job: scriptText (or scriptPath, project-relative), one sentence per line, one wav per sentence with Piper, concatenated with gapMs of silence between sentences (default 900) into work/voice/voice.wav at 48 kHz mono, transcribed by Whisper into work/voice/voice.words.json and described by work/voice/script-manifest.json with source: 'script'. The storyboard manifest is untouched: script mode writes its own document and the job report tells the two apart with source and track.
fixes.justification: Explicit request of the dev after the real case media/display-ads. No new endpoint or module: the same POST /projects/:slug/jobs (EP-012) job kind gains an alternative input, and the script variant of the voice artifact gets its own serialization instead of widening VoiceTrackSource, which would have changed the meaning of the storyboard manifest for every existing consumer. Solo profile FIX GATE, no cycle open.

fixes.author: e-burgos
fixes.title: the producer cannot synthesize voice, loses the model of the turn and blames a missing API key
fixes.description: Three defects of the producer turn seen on the real project media/display-ads. (a) Piper is not on the allowed-tools list, so the agent cannot synthesize voice at all: it can neither run the binary nor, before FIX-e-burgos-009-001, reach the voice job without a storyboard. (b) The model the user picks in the chat governs the turn but not the jobs the agent enqueues, so a storyboard job kept running on the server default. (c) The system text never said the CLI runs on the Claude Code subscription, so on AI_AGENT_FAILED the producer told the user an API key was missing, and it had no rule about the output format, which left a 16:9 screen recording rendering vertical. The fix adds the resolved Piper path to the allowed tools (verified with a real probe), injects the model of the turn into the prompt so every storyboard/voice job carries it, and rewrites the rules about the subscription, agent failures, the output format and voice without a storyboard, in the system prompt and in the skill.
fixes.justification: Explicit request of the dev on a spec already closed, driven by a real failed production. No new endpoint, module or domain entity: one entry added to the allowed-tools list, one value injected into the system prompt, and prose in the prompt and the skill. fixes.author: e-burgos
fixes.title: the montage only takes the speech from the A-roll, so a generated voice track is never used
fixes.description: Seen on the real project media/display-ads: a 96.5 s 16:9 screen recording with no audio plus a script in work/producer/script.txt. autoMontage always reads the speech from the A-roll transcript of the catalog, so the voice job of FIX-e-burgos-009-001 (work/voice/voice.wav + voice.words.json + script-manifest.json) is unreachable from the montage: the timeline came out with the voice track pointing at the silent A-roll, captions 0 and no speech at all. The fix adds voice: 'aroll' | 'script' to autoMontage, to the CLI (--voice) and to the montage job, so in script mode the speech source is the synthesized track: concepts, B-roll and captions come from its words, the timeline voice track points at work/voice/voice.wav as an audio asset of its own, and silence pruning is off by default because the screen recording is continuous.
fixes.justification: Explicit request of the dev on a closed spec. fixes.description: Dev feedback on the suggested prompt for display-ads: a user does not know formats, job kinds or flags; saying 'It is for YouTube. Generate the voice automatically, run the montage with voice, find soft free music, logo bottom right, and render' must be enough. fixes.author: e-burgos
fixes.title: uploaded assets cannot be deleted from the studio
fixes.description: Literal dev request: 'No se pueden borrar los medios subidos.' The asset store only grows: PUT uploads and GET lists, but nothing removes. A wrong take, a duplicate or a heavy file stays in raw/ forever and keeps polluting the catalog and every montage. This fix adds DELETE /projects/:slug/assets/:role/:filename (EP-027) with the same path confinement as EP-006/EP-011, catalog cleanup, timeline reference detection (409 ASSET_IN_USE, ?force=true to override) and a Delete control on every asset card of the web library.
fixes.justification: Solo-profile FIX GATE: one new endpoint over the existing asset store, no new entity and no schema change. The contract is registered field by field in sdd/api.json (EP-027) and in the render-api README. No cycle open on spec-005.
